name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Trump imposes new tariffs on dozens of countries, citing forced labor concerns
changes.summary: The Trump administration will impose tariffs of up to 12.5% on goods from 60 U.S. trading partners accused of failing to crack down on forced labor, extending the administration's tariffs on much of the world.

changes.title: Rapid pace of interceptor and precision-guided weapons use worries Trump admin.
changes.summary: The U.S. defense industrial base isn't equipped to produce missiles rapidly enough to replenish munitions used in the war with Iran, or transferred for use to Central Command.

changes.title: U.S. attorney who served for less than an hour suing Trump administration over firing
changes.summary: A U.S. attorney who served for less than an hour is suing the Trump administration over his firing. Roger Rogoff is asking a federal court to reinstate him as U.S. Attorney for the Western District of Washington. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the legal questions in this case.

changes.title: Trump fires U.S. attorney in Washington on heels of court appointment
changes.summary: Judges on the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington had appointed Roger Rogoff as U.S. attorney in Seattle. But he was fired shortly after.

changes.title: How does Make America Healthy Again hold up against scientific scrutiny?
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02024-3 Researchers share their views on the US health policy spanning topics from vaccines to nutrition.

changes.title: A Fallen Soldier’s Angst, Love and Longing to Return Home From the Iran War
changes.summary: Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton was killed in recent days, one of 18 U.S. soldiers who have lost their lives since the beginning of the war in Iran.

changes.title: Number of U.S. Troop Deaths in Iran War Appears Lower on Pentagon Website
changes.summary: Three military officials and a Pentagon spokesman gave conflicting explanations for why the number of Americans killed in the Iran war had changed.

changes.title: The White House pushes healthy eating. It cut a landmark nutrition education program
changes.summary: Nutrition advocates and public health experts are mystified by the decision to eliminate SNAP-Ed, given the Trump administration's embrace of the Make America Healthy Again agenda. (Image credit: Rachel Wisniewski for NPR).

changes.title: U.S. Employers Forced to Fire Thousands of Immigrants, and a Showdown over Peptides
changes.summary: Plus, America says no thanks to salad.
